import gc, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from plan_worst import build
from common import validate
import planning

timings = {'dijkstra': 0.0, 'bfs': 0.0, 'dfs': 0.0, 'phases': 0, 'units': 0, 'arcs': 0}

def patched(net, source, sink):
    from heapq import heappop, heappush
    graph = net.graph; to = net.to; cap = net.cap; cost = net.cost
    size = len(graph); dual = [0]*size; units = 0; spent = 0
    INF = planning.INFINITY
    timings['arcs'] = len(to)
    while True:
        t0 = time.time()
        dist = [INF]*size; dist[source] = 0; heap = [(0, source)]
        while heap:
            distance, node = heappop(heap)
            if distance > dist[node]: continue
            base = dual[node]
            for edge in graph[node]:
                if cap[edge] > 0:
                    head = to[edge]
                    reach = distance + cost[edge] + base - dual[head]
                    if reach < dist[head]:
                        dist[head] = reach; heappush(heap, (reach, head))
        timings['dijkstra'] += time.time() - t0
        if dist[sink] >= INF: break
        for node in range(size):
            if dist[node] < INF: dual[node] += dist[node]
        price = dual[sink]
        timings['phases'] += 1
        while True:
            t0 = time.time()
            level = [-1]*size; level[source] = 0; order = [source]; head = 0
            while head < len(order):
                node = order[head]; head += 1; depth = level[node]+1; base = dual[node]
                for edge in graph[node]:
                    if cap[edge] > 0:
                        other = to[edge]
                        if level[other] < 0 and cost[edge] + base - dual[other] == 0:
                            level[other] = depth; order.append(other)
            timings['bfs'] += time.time() - t0
            if level[sink] < 0: break
            cursor = [0]*size
            while True:
                t0 = time.time()
                pushed = planning._augment_path(graph, to, cap, cost, dual, level, cursor, source, sink, INF)
                timings['dfs'] += time.time() - t0
                if not pushed: break
                units += pushed; spent += pushed*price; timings['units'] += pushed
    return units, spent

planning.min_cost_flow = patched
job = build(int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), quota_cap=int(sys.argv[4]))
ctx = validate(job)
active = {r['id']: True for r in job['requests']}
gc.disable()
t=time.time(); plan = planning.solve(ctx, active); dt=time.time()-t
print('resolved=%d cost=%d total=%.1fs arcs=%d phases=%d units=%d dijkstra=%.1f bfs=%.1f dfs=%.1f' % (
    plan['resolved'], plan['cost'], dt, timings['arcs'], timings['phases'], timings['units'],
    timings['dijkstra'], timings['bfs'], timings['dfs']))
PYEOF
